functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _platform.slugify(val text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN lower(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        unaccent(trim(val)),
        '[^a-zA-Z0-9\s-]', '', 'g'
      ),
      '[\s-]+', '-', 'g'
    )
  );
END;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
